ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House); B3-1, Community Shopping; B3-2, Community
Shopping; B3-3, Community Shopping; and C2-2, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H and Map No. 16-G in the area
bound by:

West 68" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue; the alley
next north of and parallel to West 69th Street; South Justine Street; the alley next south
of and parallel to West 69th Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Ashland
Avenue; a line 241 feet south of and parallel to West 69'" Street; South Ashland Avenue;
West 69'" Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Ashland Avenue;

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

LL War

David H. Moore
Alderman, 17° Ward
